en.calloutTitle: Read this before reusing the figures
en.calloutBody: These figures were extracted from a PDF by a language model and then checked automatically against the source text. Rows marked “To review” failed at least one check and have not been confirmed by a statistician. Always cite the original publication, not this dashboard.
en.dataLede: Every figure on this dashboard, with the page it came from and the line of text it was read from. Search, sort, open a row to see the source, export.
en.methBody: Text was extracted from the PDF page by page. A rules-based reader and a language model each transcribed the tables independently, and every cell was checked for page provenance, quoted evidence, unit and range, reconciliation with published totals, and agreement between the two readings. The notebook, the prompts and the verification report are in the repository.
en.fBuiltBody: Python, an LLM extraction pipeline, Chart.js. No tracking, no cookies, no server — a single HTML file.

en.title: Consumer Price Index – Urban Index Contributions
en.ovLede: This release presents the percentage contributions of CPI urban index components for August 2026.
en.limBody: The dataset does not contain the values 0.0 for the General Index, 1.0 for Food and non‑alcoholic beverages, 1.2 for Non‑alcoholic beverages, 10.0 for Education, 11.0 for Restaurants and hotels, 12.0 for Miscellaneous goods and services, 2.0 for Alcoholic beverages tobacco and narcotics, and 3.0 for Clothing and footwear. Each of these lines contains the values listed in the verification notes.

fr.ovLede: Cette publication présente les pourcentages de contribution des composantes de l'IPC urbain pour août 2026.
fr.limBody: Le jeu de données ne contient pas les valeurs 0,0 pour l'indice général, 1,0 pour les aliments et boissons non alcoolisées, 1,2 pour les boissons non alcoolisées, 10,0 pour l'éducation, 11,0 pour les restaurants et hôtels, 12,0 pour les biens et services divers, 2,0 pour les boissons alcoolisées, tabac et stupéfiants, et 3,0 pour les vêtements et chaussures.
